snippet.title: Berry Busy Trailer: 3 Seasons, Co-Op Tidying, Honey Yards & More! 🍓 ✨
snippet.description:
Tidying crates, pressing juice, tending honey yards, and experiencing 4 beautiful seasons, all with your best friend(s). 🍓✨

Berry Busy is a cozy organization and puzzle game coming soon to Steam. Play solo or jump into full co-op mode to tackle seasonal harvests, discover new produce, and restore order to the market.

🧺 Wishlist Berry Busy on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5426350/

KEY FEATURES:

• Full 3-Player Co-Op with Crossplatform: Sort, organize, and cooperate (or argue over crates) up to two friends. Supports Steam Deck, Mac and Linux along with Windows.

• 4 Dynamic Seasons: Experience changing weather, unique seasonal fruits, and evolving environments.

• Honey Yards & Juice Press: Interactive mechanics beyond the crates to keep your farm thriving.

• Pure Tactile Satisfaction: Crisp snaps, cozy soundscapes, and zero stress.

💛 Support Our Indie Studio:

Adding Berry Busy to your Steam wishlist gives our small indie team a massive boost and ensures you're notified the second we launch!
